name: Claude PR & Issue Review

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

    types: [created]

jobs:
  pr_review:
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip

      - name: Run PR review
        env:
          CLAUDE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_API_KEY }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          python scripts/review_pr.py ${{ github.event.number }}

  issue_review:
    if: github.event_name == 'issue_comment' && contains(github.event.comment.body, '/review-issue')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies

          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

          python scripts/review_issue.py ${{ github.event.issue.number }} "${{ github.event.comment.body }}"
